changelog:
xiaohongshu-title-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release: Generate viral Xiaohongshu (RED) titles in bulk.
- Supports various title templates (数字型, 疑问型, 对比型, 痛点型, 种草型).
- Auto-adds relevant emojis (1–3 per title, not excessive).
- Adjustable for theme, audience, quantity, and style preferences.
- Ensures optimal title length, keyword inclusion, and content compliance.
- Free tier (10 titles) and Pro tier (¥9.9/month) available.
